title: bridge zksync - Open App
meta_description: bridge zksync opens the official ZKsync Portal to move ETH and supported tokens between Ethereum and ZKsync Era.
hero_h2: Move assets between Ethereum and Era
hero_lead: bridge zksync gives users a direct path to the ZKsync Portal for moving ETH and supported tokens between Ethereum and ZKsync Era while reviewing live wallet prompts before signing.
what_is: ZKsync Portal is the official app destination for deposits and withdrawals between Ethereum and ZKsync Era. ZKsync Era is a Layer 2 ZK rollup built with the ZK Stack and secured by validity proofs submitted to Ethereum; see ZKsync Era docs.

how.d: Open the portal and connect a wallet that supports Ethereum and ZKsync Era.
Choose the source and destination networks, then select ETH or another supported token shown in the app.
Check the recipient, network, amount, and wallet-estimated fees before approving.
Submit the transaction and use the portal or explorer to follow status.

points.p: Primary action opens portal.zksync.io, keeping the landing page focused on routing users to the real transaction flow.
Era executes transactions off-chain and posts validity proofs to Ethereum, according to the official documentation.
Completed transactions can be inspected on the ZKsync Era explorer.

faq.a: It is an app-first landing path for users who want to move assets between Ethereum and ZKsync Era, with the action sent to the official ZKsync Portal.

faq.q: Is this the official ZKsync bridge app?
faq.a: No. This landing page is separate from the official app; use portal.zksync.io for the transaction flow and verify the domain before signing.

faq.q: Which assets can I move to ZKsync Era?
faq.a: The live portal shows supported assets and routes. ETH is commonly used for funding, but token availability should always be confirmed in the app.

faq.q: How long do ZKsync withdrawals take?
faq.a: Timing can vary by route, wallet, and network conditions; use the app's live status and the explorer for the current transaction record.

faq.q: What should I verify before using a ZKsync bridge?
faq.a: Confirm the domain, wallet network, destination address, token, amount, and wallet prompt details. Treat copied links and search ads carefully.

footer_note: Not the official app; verify portal.zksync.io before signing. Educational content only, not financial advice.
